name: Generative Dashboard
description: Composes a full-board dashboard from variables you pick across your other plugins, using an LLM to surface whatever matters right now.
author: FiestaBoard Team

api_base_url.title: API Base URL
api_base_url.description: Any OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1, or http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama).

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Use any value for local endpoints that do not check it.

model.title: Model
model.description: Any model the endpoint serves. gpt-4o-mini is plenty for this.

output_mode.title: Output Mode
output_mode.description: grid lays stats out in tiles; prose writes a short sentence about what changed.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Low values keep the layout steady. This is layout, not art.

refresh_seconds.title: Minimum Time Between AI Updates (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often the AI may be asked to redraw the board, at most. It is only asked when a value has actually changed, so a quiet board costs nothing — this is the ceiling on how often it can happen. 300 is five minutes; raise it to 1800 for a calmer, cheaper board.

default_threshold_pct.title: How Much a Number Must Move (%)
default_threshold_pct.description: A value has to move by at least this much before the board is worth redrawing. Higher means a stiller board and fewer AI calls. Text values always count as changed when they differ.

use_color.title: Color Accents
use_color.description: Let the model flag an outlier with a single colored tile.

watchlist.title: Limit To Specific Variables (optional)
watchlist.description: Leave this empty and every variable from your enabled plugins is sent to the AI, which picks what to show. Add variables here only to restrict it to those — for example to keep the board on one subject, or to mute something that changes constantly.

ui:options.placeholder: Empty means everything. Add rows only to restrict.

labels.title: Display Labels
labels.description: Filled in by the variable picker above — the small box beside each chosen row.

pinned.title: Always Show These
pinned.description: Variables that must appear even on a quiet day.

notes.title: Variable Note
notes.description: The single most useful thing here. Tell the AI what a number means and it ranks on judgement instead of guesswork.

note.title: What it means
note.description: e.g. over 100 is unhealthy, keep the windows shut

thresholds.title: Sensitivity Override
thresholds.description: Override how far one variable must move before it is worth redrawing the board.

percent.title: Percent change
percent.description: e.g. 2 for a sensitive value, 25 for a noisy one

extra_instructions.title: Extra Prompt Instructions
extra_instructions.description: Appended to the system prompt, e.g. 'favor network stats'.

prose.description: The generated sentence, in prose mode

headline.description: The single most important stat right now

stat_count.description: How many stats are currently shown

degraded.description: Empty when healthy, otherwise why the board is degraded

generated_at.description: When the composition was last generated
